summary: numpy 2.0 upgrade blocks `import nibabel`: first at np.sctypes in nibabel/casting.py:717 (confirmed after-fail/before-ok), second at np.maximum_sctype in nibabel/quaternions.py:32 (confirmed by peeled snippet). Shimming both allows import. Deeper: ndarray.newbyteorder is removed and will break call paths (confirmed probe); np.longcomplex is removed and will break call paths where executed (likely, conditional import masks it); np.row_stack and numpy.compat still work with deprecation warnings (confirmed not breaking). NEP50 float32/promote_types changes remain unconfirmed behavior risk.

disp Use your own printing function instead.

geterrobj Use the np.errstate context manager instead.

maximum_sctype Use a specific dtype instead.
NumPy 2.0 changes promotion (the result of combining dissimilar data types) as per NEP 50 .

row_stack Use np.vstack instead ( row_stack was an alias for vstack ).

tracemalloc_domain It’s now available from np.lib .
trapz Use np.trapezoid or a scipy.integrate function instead.
